lines.zh: 我一路黏着地面往前走。
lines.en: I go forward, sticking to the ground as I go.

lines.zh: 玩具维度的地板太滑，正好。
lines.en: The Toy dimension's floor is slick — good.

lines.zh: 每走一步，都留下一小摊黏液。
lines.en: Every step leaves a little puddle of goo.

lines.zh: 我脚底的胶拉出细丝。
lines.en: Thin strings of glue trail from my soles.

lines.zh: 八十五点生命，走起来沉甸甸。
lines.en: Eighty-five health makes a heavy walk.

lines.zh: 我绕过积木塔，朝你挪。
lines.en: I skirt the block tower and shuffle toward you.

lines.zh: 你跑得越急，我黏得越紧。
lines.en: The faster you run, the tighter I stick.

lines.zh: 我的鞋底和地面在拉锯。
lines.en: My soles and the floor are in a tug of war.

lines.zh: 玩具的彩漆沾了我一身。
lines.en: Toy paint smears all over me.

lines.zh: 我不是追，我是黏过去。
lines.en: I'm not chasing; I'm oozing over.

lines.zh: 弯下腰走，更容易贴上你。
lines.en: Bent low, I cling to you more easily.

lines.zh: 这条路我走过，痕迹还在。
lines.en: I've walked this way; the trail is still there.

lines.zh: 站着时，我身上的胶往下滴。
lines.en: Standing still, my glue drips slowly.

lines.zh: 我在捏手里那团黏稠的东西。
lines.en: I knead the sticky lump in my hands.

lines.zh: 小丑的脸不能哭，只能笑。
lines.en: A clown's face can't cry; it can only grin.

lines.zh: 八十五点生命，够我玩很久。
lines.en: Eighty-five health is plenty for a long game.

lines.zh: 玩具城的音乐盒又卡住了。
lines.en: The toy city's music box is stuck again.

lines.zh: 我数着滴落的黏液，十七滴。
lines.en: I count the drips: seventeen so far.

lines.zh: 别碰我的彩球，那是我的。
lines.en: Don't touch my painted ball; it's mine.

lines.zh: 我笑着，你看不出我在想什么。
lines.en: I'm smiling; you can't tell what I'm thinking.

lines.zh: 胶干了会变硬，我得动一动。
lines.en: The glue hardens when dry, so I keep moving.

lines.zh: 我一个人也能玩得很开心。
lines.en: I can have plenty of fun alone.

lines.zh: 我歪着涂白的脸看你。
lines.en: I tilt my whitened face and look at you.

lines.zh: 你也想玩吗？我正好缺个伴。
lines.en: Want to play? I could use a partner.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛是两个黑点。
lines.en: My eyes are just two black dots.

lines.zh: 你站那么远，我够不着。
lines.en: You stand so far away; I can't reach.

lines.zh: 别转头，看着我笑一下。
lines.en: Don't turn away; smile at me once.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的剑，很好玩。
lines.en: I stare at your sword — what a fun toy.

lines.zh: 你的表情变了，我喜欢。
lines.en: Your expression changed. I like that.

lines.zh: 我一笑，嘴角就黏住了。
lines.en: When I smile, my lips stick together.

lines.zh: 玩具维度里，人是稀客。
lines.en: In the Toy dimension, people are rare guests.

lines.zh: 你再看我一会儿，我就过去。
lines.en: Look at me a moment longer and I'll come over.

lines.zh: 你砍在我身上，剑黏住了。
lines.en: Your blade hit me and stuck fast.

lines.zh: 我裂开一道口子，流出黏液。
lines.en: A split opens and goo runs out.

lines.zh: 八十五点生命，掉得不多。
lines.en: Eighty-five health — barely dented.

lines.zh: 疼是疼，可我还是在笑。
lines.en: It hurts, but I'm still smiling.

lines.zh: 你砍得越狠，胶溅得越远。
lines.en: The harder you cut, the farther glue splashes.

lines.zh: 我的伤口会自己黏回去。
lines.en: My wounds glue themselves shut.

lines.zh: 别碰那些黏液，会粘住你。
lines.en: Don't touch that goo; it'll hold you.

lines.zh: 你伤到我了，这不好玩。
lines.en: You hurt me. That isn't fun.

lines.zh: 我退开，是怕你弄脏我。
lines.en: I back off so you don't dirty me.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，把痛甩出去。
lines.en: I shake myself and fling the pain off.

lines.zh: 糖？我身上全是糖浆。
lines.en: Candy? I'm covered in syrup already.

lines.zh: 你手里的蛋糕，看着就黏。
lines.en: That cake in your hand looks sticky.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只想找个人玩。
lines.en: I'm not hungry; I just want someone to play with.

lines.zh: 把饼干放下，我们玩别的。
lines.en: Put the cookie down; let's play something else.

lines.zh: 甜味会招虫子，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Sweetness draws bugs. I don't like it.

lines.zh: 你伸手喂我，我就抓住手。
lines.en: Reach out to feed me and I'll grab the hand.

lines.zh: 那些糖果留着自己吃吧。
lines.en: Save those sweets for yourself.

lines.zh: 食物黏手，不如你黏手。
lines.en: Food is sticky; you're stickier.

lines.zh: 你晃那袋糖，我只觉得吵。
lines.en: Rattling that bag of candy just sounds noisy.

lines.zh: 我感兴趣的，是会动的东西。
lines.en: What interests me is anything that moves.

lines.zh: 撞上我，你的袖子就归我了。
lines.en: Bump into me and your sleeve is mine.

lines.zh: 我身上这层胶，专粘布料。
lines.en: This layer of glue loves cloth.

lines.zh: 你推我，手就拔不回去。
lines.en: Push me and your hand won't come back.

lines.zh: 相撞之后，我们黏成一对。
lines.en: After we collide, we're stuck as a pair.

lines.zh: 我故意往你身上靠。
lines.en: I lean into you on purpose.

lines.zh: 手别乱动，胶可不认人。
lines.en: Keep your hands still; the glue knows no mercy.

lines.zh: 八十五点生命的重量压过来。
lines.en: Eighty-five health of weight leans in.

lines.zh: 我的肩撞上你的盾，粘住了。
lines.en: My shoulder hits your shield and sticks.

lines.zh: 你后退，胶丝还连着。
lines.en: You step back, and the glue threads stretch.

lines.zh: 撞一下就当握手吧。
lines.en: Let's call that collision a handshake.

lines.zh: 玩具维度里的同类，都躲着我。
lines.en: My kin in the Toy dimension avoid me.

lines.zh: 我太黏了，没人受得了。
lines.en: I'm too clingy; nobody can stand it.

lines.zh: 两个人的胶会粘成一团。
lines.en: Two of us would gum into one lump.

lines.zh: 我只想找玩伴，不是伴侣。
lines.en: I want a playmate, not a partner.

lines.zh: 那些小丑都躲进盒子里了。
lines.en: The other clowns hid in their boxes.

lines.zh: 我笑得再响，也没人应。
lines.en: I laugh loudly, and no one answers.

lines.zh: 一个人也能把球抛起来。
lines.en: I can toss the ball up alone.

lines.zh: 我的椅子上只坐得下一个。
lines.en: Only one of me fits on my chair.

lines.zh: 配对要两个人愿意，我不勉强。
lines.en: Pairing takes two willing; I won't force it.

lines.zh: 孤独的胶，干得特别快。
lines.en: Lonely glue dries especially fast.

lines.zh: 地上有颗彩球，我捡起来了。
lines.en: A painted ball on the floor — I picked it up.

lines.zh: 我捡东西从不用手，用黏的。
lines.en: I pick things up with stick, not hands.

lines.zh: 你掉的剑粘在我掌心了。
lines.en: Your dropped sword stuck to my palm.

lines.zh: 我把积木一块块摞起来。
lines.en: I stack the toy blocks one by one.

lines.zh: 东西捡多了，走起来更慢。
lines.en: The more I pick up, the slower I walk.

lines.zh: 那枚硬币在我手里转不动。
lines.en: The coin won't spin, stuck in my hand.

lines.zh: 我怀里已经塞了三个玩偶。
lines.en: I've already stuffed three dolls into my arms.

lines.zh: 掉落物？我只捡好玩的。
lines.en: Loot? I only pick up the fun things.

lines.zh: 捡起来又粘住，甩不掉。
lines.en: I pick it up and it sticks; can't shake it off.

lines.zh: 你掉的苹果，我当球玩。
lines.en: The apple you dropped makes a fine ball.

lines.zh: 你走进玩具城，就是新玩具。
lines.en: Enter the toy city and you're my new toy.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，别躲了。
lines.en: I see you. Stop hiding.

lines.zh: 今天我选中你陪我玩。
lines.en: Today I've chosen you to play with me.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声在木地板上很响。
lines.en: Your steps ring loud on the wooden floor.

lines.zh: 八点五的伤害，是游戏规则。
lines.en: Eight and a half damage — those are the rules.

lines.zh: 我把你圈进来了。
lines.en: I've drawn you into my circle.

lines.zh: 你一跑，我这条腿就更黏。
lines.en: Run, and my legs get even stickier.

lines.zh: 我的目标只有一个，很好找。
lines.en: I've one target only, and you're easy to find.

lines.zh: 玩具城今天有客人了。
lines.en: The toy city has a guest today.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的胶了，算你倒霉。
lines.en: You stepped in my glue — bad luck.

lines.zh: 我笑着锁定了你。
lines.en: Smiling, I've locked onto you.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，和塑料不一样。
lines.en: You don't smell like plastic at all.

lines.zh: 游戏开始，规则由我定。
lines.en: The game starts, and I make the rules.

lines.zh: 我数到三就过去，一、二。
lines.en: I'll come at three. One. Two.

lines.zh: 积木塔后头那个影子，是你吧。
lines.en: That shadow behind the block tower — that's you, isn't it?

lines.zh: 我把门虚掩着，就等你进来。
lines.en: I left the door ajar, waiting for you to come in.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，假装在系鞋带。
lines.en: I crouch and pretend to tie my shoes.

lines.zh: 你后退，我就笑得更开。
lines.en: You back away; my grin widens.

lines.zh: 我在等你放松那一秒。
lines.en: I'm waiting for the second you relax.

lines.zh: 手里的胶已经热了。
lines.en: The glue in my hands has gone warm.

lines.zh: 你握剑的姿势太紧了。
lines.en: You're gripping that sword too tightly.

lines.zh: 玩具城的灯一闪一闪，真好看。
lines.en: The toy city lights blink. Lovely.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走，留下一圈胶印。
lines.en: I circle you, leaving a ring of glue.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，游戏更有趣。
lines.en: You've backed to a corner; the game improves.

lines.zh: 我不急，我等你脚滑。
lines.en: I'm patient; I'll wait for you to slip.

lines.zh: 八十五点生命，够我耗。
lines.en: Eighty-five health is enough to outlast you.

lines.zh: 我的笑是粘上去的，撕不下来。
lines.en: My smile is glued on; it won't peel.

lines.zh: 你看我，我就往前进一寸。
lines.en: You look at me; I inch forward.

lines.zh: 这场捉迷藏，你藏得不好。
lines.en: You're not very good at this hiding game.

lines.zh: 数到三之前，我还可以反悔。
lines.en: Before three, I could still change my mind.

lines.zh: 我不追，我等你踩进胶里。
lines.en: I don't chase; I wait for you to step in the glue.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底沾了东西，走不快了。
lines.en: Something's stuck to your soles; you can't move fast now.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，看你先往哪边跑。
lines.en: I tilt my head to see which way you'll run first.

lines.zh: 那辆玩具车在响，是我放的。
lines.en: That toy cart rattling — I put it there.

lines.zh: 我伸出手，掌心朝上，很客气。
lines.en: I hold out my hand, palm up, polite as can be.

lines.zh: 再走两步，那条线就到了。
lines.en: Two more steps and you're at the line.

lines.zh: 我一巴掌拍上来，黏住了。
lines.en: I slap you once, and it sticks.

lines.zh: 八点五的伤害，外加一层胶。
lines.en: Eight and a half damage, plus a coat of glue.

lines.zh: 别擦，越擦越黏。
lines.en: Don't wipe it; it only spreads.

lines.zh: 我打你的时候还在笑。
lines.en: I'm still grinning while I hit you.

lines.zh: 这一拳软，但拔不掉。
lines.en: The punch is soft, but you can't pull free.

lines.zh: 你的护甲缝里进了我的胶。
lines.en: My glue has gotten into your armor's seams.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手腕，轻轻一扯。
lines.en: I catch your wrist and give a gentle pull.

lines.zh: 打中之后，我的手留在原地。
lines.en: After the hit, my hand stays right there.

lines.zh: 你挥剑的动作慢下来了。
lines.en: Your sword swing is slowing down.

lines.zh: 我把你往积木塔上推。
lines.en: I shove you toward the block tower.

lines.zh: 这一下不算重，就是有点脏。
lines.en: Not a heavy blow — just a messy one.

lines.zh: 你甩手的样子，真好笑。
lines.en: The way you shake your hand is funny.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，胶丝还拉着。
lines.en: I step back half a pace; the threads still hold.

lines.zh: 玩到这一步，你可别哭。
lines.en: We've played this far; don't start crying.

lines.zh: 我的手贴在你背上，撕不开。
lines.en: My hand is stuck to your back and won't peel off.

lines.zh: 这一下打偏了，可胶没偏。
lines.en: The swing missed, but the glue didn't.

lines.zh: 你的剑被我攥住，抽不回去。
lines.en: I've got your sword; you can't pull it back.

lines.zh: 我笑得很大声，手也没停。
lines.en: I laugh loudly, and my hands don't stop.

lines.zh: 胶丝从你肩上一直挂到地上。
lines.en: Glue strings hang from your shoulder to the floor.

lines.zh: 我把你按在积木上，轻轻的。
lines.en: I press you onto the blocks, gently.

lines.zh: 玩具城的盒子自己打开了。
lines.en: A box in the toy city opens by itself.

lines.zh: 我从一堆彩球里挤出半个身子。
lines.en: I squeeze half out of a pile of painted balls.

lines.zh: 地上先出现一摊黏液，然后是我。
lines.en: First a puddle of goo, then me.

lines.zh: 八十五点生命，从盒子里带出来。
lines.en: Eighty-five health, packed in the box with me.

lines.zh: 我的笑脸是新的，胶还是旧的。
lines.en: New grin, old glue.

lines.zh: 这里的玩具都看着我。
lines.en: All the toys here are watching me.

lines.zh: 我一站起来，地板就粘住了。
lines.en: I stand, and the floor sticks to me.

lines.zh: 有人把我落在这儿了。
lines.en: Someone left me here.

lines.zh: 玩具城又多了个小丑。
lines.en: The toy city has one more clown.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，黏液甩得到处都是。
lines.en: I shake myself, flinging goo everywhere.

lines.zh: 盒子里的空气太闷了。
lines.en: The air in that box was stifling.

lines.zh: 我出来第一件事，就是找人。
lines.en: First thing out, I look for someone.

lines.zh: 火烤得胶发硬，我更难动了。
lines.en: Fire hardens my glue and I stiffen.

lines.zh: 摔下来时，胶替我垫了一层。
lines.en: Falling, my glue cushions the landing.

lines.zh: 水把我泡开了，我变得很淡。
lines.en: Water thins me out; I go pale and runny.

lines.zh: 炸得我四分五裂，又黏回去。
lines.en: The blast scatters me; I glue myself back.

lines.zh: 箭插进胶里，走不动了。
lines.en: The arrow lodges in my glue and stops.

lines.zh: 魔法把我的胶烧成一缕烟。
lines.en: Magic burns my glue into a wisp of smoke.

lines.zh: 我不用吃饭，只是没力气。
lines.en: I don't eat; I just run out of strength.

lines.zh: 雷打过来，我整个人抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits and my whole body jolts.

lines.zh: 虚空把我拉长，像一根糖丝。
lines.en: The void stretches me like a strand of sugar.
